name: stackblitz-hello-world
description: Build a minimal, controlled WebContainer smoke test that boots once, mounts a small project, observes process exit, and captures the preview URL. Use when proving browser/runtime compatibility before building a larger in-browser development experience. Trigger with "StackBlitz hello world", "test WebContainers", or "run Node in the browser".
